feedback_by_option.fil: Maaaring makapinsala ang shortcut: Huwag magbigay ng iisang homemade timpla o dami para sa lahat ng edad at sachet. Huwag piliting painumin kung hindi ligtas lumunok.
feedback_by_option.en: The shortcut can cause harm: Do not give a fixed homemade recipe or fluid dose across all ages and packet sizes. Do not force oral fluids when swallowing is unsafe.
